title: 西南门 Xi Nan Men
subtitle: Gate in the garden walls

model.line: No box of its own: the hall drawn at this point stands for the gate in the 3D view.

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考: the eighteen gates
evidence.excerpt_zh: 園内為門十八南曰大宫門曰左右門曰東西夾道門曰東西如意門曰福園門曰西南門曰水閘門曰藻園門東曰東樓門曰鐡門曰明春門曰隨墻門曰蘂珠宫門西曰隨墻門正北曰北樓門為閘三西南為一空進水閘東北為五空出水閘為一空出水閘
evidence.summary: The Qing list of the gates of 圆明园 and of its three sluices, to set against the labels of S01.

evidence.title: 玉明 侍游御園記: the gates on his route, 1856
evidence.date: 咸豐六年七月二十一日 1856
evidence.locator: 蕉軒隨錄, 御園侍游
evidence.excerpt_zh: 午初一刻进西南门……过蕊珠宫门，至黄花磴进茶毕……由宝相寺、法慧寺、谐奇趣过明春门，至雷峰夕照马头……进丽春门骑马，由旧园东墙根过敷春堂，游西大堤汉城关，至含辉楼下马
evidence.summary: A guard officer's route: in by 西南门, past 蕊珠宫门 to the European palaces, back by 明春门 to 福海, in by 丽春门, along the old wall past 敷春堂. Shows the name 敷春堂 in use in 1856, and 丽春门 (not yet tied to a plan label). The rest of this passage has its own entry.

evidence.title: 宣宗實錄: stone roads to 福园门 and 西南门, 1828
evidence.locator: 道光八年十二月戊寅 (corpus copy)
evidence.link: https://github.com/garychowcmu/daizhigev20/blob/master/史藏/别史/清实录道光朝实录.txt
evidence.excerpt_zh: 所有西直门至圆明园、及阜成门西便门福园门西南门扇子河南岸、并佟府栅栏内外石道桥座涵洞等项工程
evidence.summary: Works on the stone roads to the garden name these two as road ends, so both were public approaches.

evidence.title: Malone: gates of the south side, 大宫门 and second gate
evidence.summary: The present 出入贤良门 lies on the line of the south wall, while the Great Palace Gate opens through a shorter wall like a bay: Malone reads it as a later addition. He notes 藻园门 lies west of 西南门, which makes the name 西南门 a misnomer, and supposes 藻园门 was added later.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum and Historical Photographs of China; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn as a gate on the plan of the gardens (S01).
